description_en: Security Center provides rewards such as value-added service authorization quotas and log analysis storage capacity to users who complete tasks. Queries the completion status and reward information of configuration tasks
description_zh: 云安全中心为完成任务的用户提供了增值服务授权数、日志分析存储容量等奖励。调用该接口可查询配置任务的完成情况和奖励信息
name: QueryGuidTaskList

GuideTaskConfigList.description_en: The list of beginner task information

RewardData.description_en: The reward information for task completion

IsRewardTaked.description_en:
The claim status. Valid values:
1: Not claimed.
2: Claimed
IsRewardTaked.description_zh:
领取状态。取值：
1：未领取
2：已领取

Reward.description_en:
The reward name. Valid values:
addTrialDay: trial days reward
addAntiRansomwareCapacity: anti-ransomware capacity reward
addImageScanAuthCount: image scan authorization quota reward
addWebLockAuthCount: web tamper-proofing authorization quota reward
addSlsCapacity: log analysis storage capacity reward
Reward.description_zh:
奖励名称。取值：
addTrialDay：奖励试用天数
addAntiRansomwareCapacity：奖励防勒索容量
addImageScanAuthCount：奖励镜像安全扫描授权数
addWebLockAuthCount：奖励网页防篡改授权数
addSlsCapacity：奖励日志分析存储空间

RewardConfig.description_en:
The reward configuration information. This parameter is in JSON format.
The key in the JSON object indicates the reward content, and the value indicates the reward amount. Valid values of the key:
webLockAuthCount: the web tamper-proofing authorization quota
ransomwareCapacity: the anti-ransomware capacity, in GB
slsCapacity: the log analysis capacity, in GB
days: the number of usage days
imageScanAuthCount: the image scan authorization quota
honeypotAuthCount: the cloud honeypot authorization quota
RewardConfig.description_zh:
奖励配置信息。该参数为JSON格式。
其中JSON的Key为奖励内容，Value为奖励值。Key取值如下：
webLockAuthCount：网页防篡改授权数
ransomwareCapacity：防勒索容量，单位GB
slsCapacity：日志分析容量，单位GB
days：使用天数
imageScanAuthCount：镜像扫描授权数
honeypotAuthCount：云蜜罐授权数

SecurityScore.description_en: The security score increase that can be gained by completing this task
SecurityScore.description_zh: 完成该任务可提升安全评分的分值

Status.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:
0: Closed.
1: In progress.
2: Completed
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。取值：
0：已关闭
1：执行中
2：已完成

TaskTypeName.description_en:
The node name. Valid values:

guid_task_security_score_promote_video: the node of watching the beginner quick start video
guide_sub_task_config_defence_hbr: the anti-ransomware configuration node for servers
guide_sub_task_config_uni_defence_hbr: the anti-ransomware configuration node for databases
guid_task_log_analysis_config: the log analysis node
guide_sub_task_web_lock_config: the web tamper-proofing node
guide_sub_task_config_anti_crack: the anti-brute-force attacks node
guid_task_container_security_video: the container security video node
guid_task_container_image_scan_config: the container image scan node
guid_task_k8s_log_analysis_config: the Kubernetes threat detection node
guid_task_container_network: the container visualization node
guide_sub_task_config_add_collection: the node of adding the console to favorites
guide_sub_task_vul_scan: the vulnerability scanning node
guide_sub_task_virusKill: the virus scan node
TaskTypeName.description_zh:

guid_task_security_score_promote_video：观看新手快速入门视频任务

guide_sub_task_config_uni_defence_hbr：数据库防勒索配置任务

guid_task_k8s_log_analysis_config：Kubernetes威胁检测任务
guid_task_container_network：容器可视化任务
guide_sub_task_config_add_collection：收藏控制台任务
guide_sub_task_vul_scan：漏洞扫描任务

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique ID for each request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
